summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, reporting routine issuance of 9,255 ordinary shares to satisfy vesting of awards under its Save for Shares Plan. The shares were issued between March 14 and April 30, 2026, are fungible with existing shares, and were admitted to trading on the London Stock Exchange Main Market under a block admission dated January 19, 2024. This is an ordinary equity issuance for employee benefit purposes, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or advisor mentioned. No further action or risk-arb angle.
